title: Jazz reportedly agree to 2-year deal with Josh Okogie
summary: NBA.com relays ESPN's Shams Charania report that Utah agreed to a two-year, $12 million contract with veteran guard Josh Okogie.

title: Knicks reportedly sign Andre Drummond for frontcourt depth
summary: NBA.com reports ESPN and HoopsHype say Andre Drummond agreed to a one-year deal with the defending champion Knicks.

title: Clippers reportedly agree to 3-year deal with Jordan Miller
summary: NBA.com relays ESPN's Shams Charania report that restricted free agent Jordan Miller is returning to LA on a three-year, $15.3 million contract.

title: Wizards reportedly add Deandre Ayton in Lakers trade
summary: NBA.com cites ESPN's Shams Charania on a reported deal sending Deandre Ayton to Washington for Jaden Hardy and two future second-round picks.

title: Hornets reportedly acquire Dorian Finney-Smith from Rockets
summary: NBA.com relays ESPN's Shams Charania report that Houston is sending Dorian Finney-Smith and three second-round picks to Charlotte.

title: Celtics reportedly agree to 4-year deal with Neemias Queta
summary: NBA.com cites ESPN's Shams Charania on Boston's reported four-year, $56 million agreement with center Neemias Queta.

title: Rockets reportedly re-sign Tari Eason on 5-year deal
summary: NBA.com reports ESPN has Tari Eason returning to Houston on a five-year, $81 million deal, with The Athletic reporting a fifth-year player option.

title: Raptors extend coach Darko Rajakovic
summary: Toronto officially announced a multi-year extension for Darko Rajakovic after the Raptors improved by 16 wins and earned the East's No. 5 seed.

title: Sixers reportedly agree to 2-year deal with Anfernee Simons
summary: NBA.com says multiple reports, including ESPN's Shams Charania and Marc Stein, have Anfernee Simons joining Philadelphia on a two-year deal.

title: Sixers reportedly set to acquire Jaylen Brown from Celtics
summary: NBA.com reports ESPN first had the Jaylen Brown-for-Paul George framework, with The Athletic and The Boston Globe also confirming the deal.

title: Lakers reportedly add Sexton, Grimes and Mamukelashvili
summary: NBA.com cites multiple reports that the Lakers reached agreements with Collin Sexton, Quentin Grimes and Sandro Mamukelashvili.

title: Lakers reportedly add Walker Kessler in Jazz trade
summary: NBA.com says multiple reports have Utah sending Walker Kessler to the Lakers for two unprotected first-round picks and two pick swaps.

title: Raptors reportedly agree to acquire Kawhi Leonard from Clippers
summary: NBA.com cites multiple reports that Toronto is reacquiring Kawhi Leonard for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick and a package of draft picks.

title: LeBron James reportedly plans to leave Lakers
summary: NBA.com reports multiple outlets citing Klutch Sports CEO Rich Paul say LeBron James plans to play for a team other than the Lakers in 2026-27.
